description: This file defines backbone modules for object detection, including a frozen BatchNorm layer, backbone base class, specific ResNet backbone, and a joiner class for combining backbone outputs with position encoding. It also includes a builder function for creating the backbone model.

classes.name: FrozenBatchNorm2d
classes.description: A BatchNorm2d layer with fixed batch statistics and affine parameters.

classes.name: BackboneBase
classes.description: Base class for backbone models, managing layer freezing and output extraction.

classes.name: Backbone
classes.description: ResNet backbone with frozen BatchNorm, configurable by name and dilation.

classes.name: Joiner
classes.description: Sequential module combining backbone and position embedding, producing outputs and positional encodings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for each class, initializing parameters and layers.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict
methods.description: Loads state dict, handling batch tracking key removal.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Defines forward pass for each class, processing input tensors.

methods.name: build_backbone
methods.description: Builds and returns a backbone model with position encoding based on input arguments.
